subject: Request to reclassify pilot grant and offset invoice — tax/ledger note
messages:
From: Asha Mehta <asha@nimbus.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance@nimbus.io
Date: Fri, 27 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Reclassification request — pilot grant applied as invoice offset

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for running the pilot with us — overall great results. We discovered during an internal audit that the $50,000 pilot grant Redwood applied as an invoice offset against invoice #IM-2047 needs to be reclassified on our books as a promotional allowance (contra-revenue) for FY27 rather than an offset to accounts receivable.

Attached is the credit memo Redwood issued on 2028-04-15 (nimbus_credit_memo_0427.pdf) and an excerpt of the pilot T&Cs. Our tax team says the original treatment may affect our revenue recognition and sales tax filings in a few jurisdictions. Can Redwood issue a sideletter confirming that you will reclassify the posting on your side (provide the journal entry details) and reissue any internal tax documentation we need?

We'd like to close this by the end of next week if possible. Happy to join a quick call to align.

Best,
Asha Mehta
Director, Finance — Nimbus Labs
asha@nimbus.io
Attachments: nimbus_credit_memo_0427.pdf, pilot_contract_excerpt.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Mehta <asha@nimbus.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Apr 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reclassification request — pilot grant applied as invoice offset

Hi Asha,

Thanks for flagging this and for the attachments. Looping in Finance and RevOps so we can confirm the ledger treatment and provide the sideletter you requested.

Internal team — Nimbus is asking that the $50k pilot credit be recorded as a promotional allowance (contra-revenue) instead of an invoice offset. They flagged potential tax/recognition impacts across jurisdictions and want a written confirmation and journal entry details from us. Can you weigh in on whether we can reclassify post-billing and what the knock-on tax steps will be?

I can schedule a 20-minute sync with Nimbus next week if that helps.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0192

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Apr 2028 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Reclassification request — pilot grant applied as invoice offset

Jordan / team,

Quick notes after a first pass with Accounting: we can support a post-bill reclassification, but there are a few requirements and impacts to document. High level:

- Recommended treatment: record the $50,000 as contra-revenue (GL code 4005) rather than as an AR offset. This aligns with Nimbus' ask and keeps our revenue recognition intact for the performance period.
- Journal entry (proposed): DR Sales returns/allowances (GL 4005) $50,000; CR Cash/Bank or AR clearing (depending on the original posting) $50,000. See attached proposed_journal_entries_0429.xlsx for exact lines and tax implications per jurisdiction.
- Timing & audit trail: Because the invoice has already been cleared with their credit, we'll create a reversing entry plus a contra-revenue posting dated to the original invoice period to avoid restating revenue for prior closed periods where possible. If Nimbus needs a restatement for their tax filings, we will coordinate but that may require document exchange (sideletter + signed confirmation).
- Tax: Sales tax correction is client-side in most jurisdictions, but where we collected and remitted tax, we will provide the documentation Nimbus needs to claim a refund or adjustment.
- Controls: Need signed sideletter from Nimbus confirming the requested treatment and acceptance of any tax adjustments. Once we have that, FP&A will post the entries and RevOps will update the customer ledger.

Laura / Neha — can you confirm last bullet (controls) and whether we need CFO approval for >$25k contra postings?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Finance Manager — Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposed_journal_entries_0429.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 May 2028 11:14:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Reclassification request — pilot grant applied as invoice offset

Marcus, Jordan —

Confirmed: FP&A can post the reversing + contra-revenue entries once we receive a signed sideletter from Nimbus. Per our finance policy, any contra-revenue > $25k requires a Controller signoff; I'll take that to Controller and loop back.

Operational steps we will take once signed confirmation is received:
- Generate sideletter template (I will draft and include the journal entry language).
- Create memo for tax team detailing jurisdictions affected and supporting docs to send to Nimbus.
- Post entries in a suspense/reclassification batch to keep Audit trail clean.

Neha — please confirm estimated posting date after we receive the signed sideletter (I expect 2 business days for journal prep + 1 business day for posting).

Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Mehta <asha@nimbus.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 May 2028 14:15:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Reclassification request — pilot grant applied as invoice offset

Hi Asha,

Thanks for sending the credit memo. We can accommodate Nimbus' request to reclassify the $50,000 pilot grant as a promotional allowance (contra-revenue). To proceed we need: 1) a signed sideletter from Nimbus confirming the requested change and accepting any tax remittance consequences, and 2) confirmation of the primary tax jurisdiction(s) for this transaction.

What we'll do once we have the signed sideletter:
- FP&A will post a reversing entry + contra-revenue journal backdated to the original invoice period.
- RevOps will update the customer ledger and provide a short accounting memo summarizing entries for your records.
- Our tax team will prepare documents to support any refund/adjustment claims you need to file.

I've attached a draft sideletter and proposed journal language for your review (attached: proposed_journal_entries_0429.xlsx — includes sample memo language and GLA details). Can you review and return a signed copy via DocuSign (link below) or attach the signed PDF? If you'd prefer a 20-minute call to walk through, I'm available tomorrow 9:30–10:30 PT.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.net/signer/xyz-3891
Attachments: proposed_journal_entries_0429.xlsx, sideletter_draft_0429.docx

Best,
Jordan Blake
